tools.name: get_okc_hvac_business_info
tools.description: Get business information for the OKC HVAC Calculator, powered by Covington Heat & Air (name, phone, email, website, service area).

tools.name: get_repair_or_replace_tool_info
tools.description: Get metadata about the repair-or-replace decision tool: what it does, assumptions, thresholds, fees, and its input schema.

tools.name: run_hvac_repair_or_replace_analysis
tools.description: Run the repair-or-replace decision engine and return a recommendation (REPAIR, REPLACE, DEPENDS, or IMMEDIATE_SERVICE) with reasoning and a multi-year cost comparison. Estimates only. Final diagnosis, equipment recommendations, availability, and pricing require an on-site evaluation.

tools.name: search_hvac_decision_content
tools.description: Search published HVAC insights articles by keyword, category, or author. Returns matching article summaries.

tools.name: get_hvac_article
tools.description: Get the full content of a single published HVAC insights article by its slug, including its direct answer and FAQ.

tools.name: get_okc_hvac_service_area
tools.description: Get the Covington Heat & Air service area, and optionally check whether a given city or ZIP is covered.

tools.name: submit_covington_lead_request
tools.description: Submit a lead (contact request) to Covington Heat & Air. Requires an API key and explicit user consent.

tools.name: submit_covington_booking_request
tools.description: Submit a booking (appointment) request to Covington Heat & Air. Requires an API key and explicit user consent.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_okc_hvac_business_info · Private data: submit_covington_lead_request, submit_covington_booking_request · Public sink: get_okc_hvac_business_info, submit_covington_lead_request, submit_covington_booking_request · Destructive: run_hvac_repair_or_replace_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_okc_hvac_business_info · Private data: submit_covington_lead_request, submit_covington_booking_request · Public sink: get_okc_hvac_business_info, submit_covington_lead_request, submit_covington_booking_request · Destructive: run_hvac_repair_or_replace_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
